rules.name: xoga713-rmo-index-and-view-check
rules.sql: SELECT c.relname AS index_name, t.relname AS table_name, i.indisvalid AS valid, i.indisready AS ready, pg_size_pretty(pg_relation_size(c.oid)) AS size FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indexrelid JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = i.indrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND c.relname IN ('idx_security_info_tenant_bu_sec', 'idx_sec_settle_value_tenant_bu_sec_vd') ORDER BY 1

SELECT c.relname AS index_name, t.relname AS table_name, i.indisvalid AS valid, i.indisready AS ready FROM pg_index i JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = i.indexrelid JOIN pg_class t ON t.oid = i.indrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND (NOT i.indisvalid OR NOT i.indisready) ORDER BY 1

SELECT p.pid, p.phase, p.index_relid::regclass::text AS index_name, p.relid::regclass::text AS table_name, p.blocks_done, p.blocks_total, p.tuples_done, p.tuples_total FROM pg_stat_progress_create_index p

SELECT pid, state, wait_event_type, wait_event, now() - query_start AS running_for, left(query, 140) AS query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE pid <> pg_backend_pid() AND (query ILIKE '%create index%' OR query ILIKE '%reindex%') ORDER BY query_start

SELECT (SELECT string_agg(id || ' ' || exectype || ' ' || to_char(dateexecuted, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), '; ') FROM opera.databasechangelog WHERE id = 'create-rmo-join-indexes-v1') AS rmo_index_changeset, (SELECT locked::int FROM opera.databasechangeloglock) AS liquibase_locked

SELECT c.relname AS table_name, c.reltuples::bigint AS approx_rows, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(c.oid)) AS total_size FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND c.relname IN ('security_info_table', 'security_settlement_value_table', 'cloned_deal_ticket_table', 'deal_ticket_table', 'premium_fy_table') ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) AS view_rows FROM opera.helper_risk_middle_office_reports WHERE LOWER(business_unit) = LOWER(:bu)
SELECT count(*) AS view_rows FROM opera.helper_risk_middle_office_reports WHERE business_unit = UPPER(:bu)

expect.reason: no INVALID or not-ready index in schema opera: an interrupted CONCURRENTLY build leaves one, and CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS then does nothing
Liquibase is not still running (a long index build keeps core from finishing its start)
